name: dev-tool-references-its-own-tunnel-endpoint
note: A dev tool that references a tunnel / reverse-proxy endpoint (trycloudflare.com) co-located with a network call. Tunnel domains were in the same HIGH list as pure exfil sinks (pastebin, webhook.site, oast.*), so the official package for each tunnel product false-BLOCKed on its own endpoint — wrangler → trycloudflare.com, ngrok → ngrok.io, localtunnel → loca.lt. Tunnels are dual-use (malware uses them for C2, dev tools embed them by design), so this is REVIEW like a URL shortener, not BLOCK. A pure exfil domain (webhook.site) still BLOCKs. Regression guard for the top-1000-B false-block fix.
